name: libevdev
description: Wrapper library for evdev input devices that abstracts common tasks (querying capabilities, reading events, SYN_DROPPED resync handling) behind a stable API, avoiding direct/erroneous ioctl use. Required by libinput to talk to kernel input devices.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
